title: Exact constant-coefficient pro-etale pullback in independent universes
statement: For arbitrary schemes X,Y in universe t, a scheme map f:X→Y and any commutative ring A in coefficient universe max r (t+1), the specified coefficientProEtaleModulePullback f A preserves finite limits and finite colimits. No finiteness, flatness or nonzero-ring assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Transport sites and coefficients to the coefficient-sized models using AsSmall. Compose the constant-sheaf and sheaf-inverse-image adjunctions; uniqueness of left adjoints identifies the result with the target constant sheaf, normalized by the constant-section map. Forget to sets to obtain the ring-unit presentation and use inverseImage_underlying_of_ring_presentation. The resulting abelian sheaf inverse image is exact since base change preserves finite limits, so reflection through toSheaf gives exactness of module inverse image. Module equivalences and uniqueness of left adjoints transport exactness to the recorded coefficientProEtaleModulePullback.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientProEtaleModulePullback_exact {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (A : CommRingCat.{max r (t + 1)}) :
    PreservesFiniteLimits (coefficientProEtaleModulePullback.{t,r} f A) ∧
      PreservesFiniteColimits (coefficientProEtaleModulePullback.{t,r} f A)
